title: Out-of-Distribution Detection using Counterfactual Distance
abstract: arXiv:2508.10148v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate and explainable out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is required to use machine learning systems safely. Previous work has shown that feature distance to decision boundaries can be used to identify OOD data effectively. In this paper, we build on this intuition and propose a post-hoc OOD detection method that, given an input, calculates the distance to decision boundaries by leveraging counterfactual explanations. Since computing explanations can be expensive for large architectures, we also propose strategies to improve scalability by computing counterfactuals directly in embedding space. Crucially, as the method employs counterfactual explanations, we can seamlessly use them to help interpret the results of our detector. We show that our method is in line with the state of the art on CIFAR-10, achieving 93.50% AUROC and 25.80% FPR95. Our method outperforms these methods on CIFAR-100 with 97.05% AUROC and 13.79% FPR95

translated_title: 基于反事实距离的分布外检测
translated_abstract: 准确且可解释的分布外（OOD）检测是安全使用机器学习系统的必要条件。先前的研究表明，特征到决策边界的距离可以有效用于识别分布外数据。在本文中，我们基于这一直觉，提出了一种事后OOD检测方法，该方法通过利用反事实解释来计算给定输入到决策边界的距离。由于对大型架构计算解释的代价可能很高，我们还提出了通过直接在嵌入空间中计算反事实来提高可扩展性的策略。至关重要的是，由于该方法采用了反事实解释，我们可以无缝地利用它们来帮助解释检测器的结果。我们的方法在CIFAR-10上达到了最先进水平，实现了93.50%的AUROC和25.80%的FPR95；并在CIFAR-100上超越了这些方法，实现了97.05%的AUROC和13.79%的FPR95。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用反事实解释计算输入到决策边界距离的事后分布外检测方法，不仅达到了最先进的检测性能（CIFAR-100上AUROC达97.05%），还能利用反事实解释为检测结果提供可解释性。
